positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Platform Engineer for Customer Experience Cloud

positions.title: Software Engineer III - Analytics
positions.description:
Khoros Analytics - greenfield Analytics product following M&A of Spredfast. Dropwizard, Kubernetes, docker, PostgreSQL, Flyway, TestContainers, React, Redux, ES6.

I also maintain our legacy Analytics product (Care Analytics). Includes scaling our AWS to ElasticSearch data pipeline, migrating from ECS to Kubernetes, leveraging Kube features to reduce service outages (probes and alerting), etc.

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Platform Microservices, Bots
positions.description:
Content ingestion and publication for major brands on social networks like Facebook, Twitter, etc. I partner with providers like Google to develop EA integration on new platforms like Google Business Messages and Google My Business.

Bot Automation Framework - Exposing RESTful APIs for customers wishing to develop automated integrations with our Care Social Care Product.

NPS/CSAT surveys following interaction with a brand on social channels like Facebook, Apple Business Chat (mobile), WhatsApp, etc. React, Redux, ES6, python, flask, AWS Lambda, serverless.

I work with Dropwizard microservices written in Java and Kotlin using DynamoDB, ECS, Docker, and a variety of other AWS products (API Gateway, Lambda, etc).

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Developed on a full-stack Agile team supporting 10+ applications that drive CDK’s daily revenue. Reduced server and development time overhead by moving legacy J2EE applications into continuous delivery with Docker, CoreOS, Bamboo, and Kubernetes. DevOps experience  in authoring new features and deploying war files to production tomcat servers. Participated in a company hackathon and created a Dev Productivity/Ops tool within Atlassian HipChat with Java, MongoDB, and Spring Boot.

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Intern
positions.description: Wrote automated tests in Python for Roku devices, such as validating system call behavior on hardware, and Roku content partners like Hulu, Netflix, and YouTube. Reported failures/diagnostics across different firmware versions using Jenkins for automated builds and deployments. Set up an automation lab to reduce manual testing on hardware like TVs and set-top boxes.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin

certifications.name: Oracle Certified Associate, Java SE 8 Programmer
certifications.title: Oracle Certified Associate, Java SE 8 Programmer

projects.title: AES-256
projects.description: Implemented the industry standard AES encryption algorithm for a 256 bit key in Java. Please message if you would like to view the source.

projects.title: Steganography
projects.description: A Java program that takes in an image and a text file and encodes the file's contents into the image with no noticeable effect to the human eye. The program can also decode an image to read a message.
